prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic cool-grey seamless editorial 3x3 contact sheet featuring one consistent adult woman matching the authorized identity reference. She has a curvy feminine silhouette, natural skin texture, softly styled shoulder-length hair, and wears a charcoal sleeveless dress. Arrange nine distinct panels: 1) tight cheek-and-neck close-up with blurred finger foreground at 85mm f/1.8; 2) eyes locked to lens with top-light reflection at 85mm f/2.0; 3) monochrome chin-on-hand portrait with strong frame fill at 50mm f/2.2; 4) half-obscured over-shoulder shot through a blurred dress strap at 85mm f/2.0; 5) head-on close-up with intersecting shadows across face at 50mm f/2.5; 6) angled tousled-hair portrait at 85mm f/2.2; 7) tight detail of hands resting near collarbone at 50mm f/3.2; 8) seated half-body profile with blurred frame edges at 35mm f/4.5; 9) profile macro with a single water-droplet highlight at 85mm f/1.9. Use a large overhead softbox, faint side bounce, smooth contrast, editorial softness, and no text or logos.
